title: Portal Chats in the phone app: swipe the top bar of an open chat
text: The swipe on an open conversation did nothing inside the TD Social app. It now works there: swipe the top bar right for Read / Unread and Pin, left for Note and Copy link.
points: Right: Read / Unread and Pin / Unpin
stepsTitle: Swiping the top bar inside the app

steps.name: Open a conversation
steps.detail: Tap it in the list as usual.

steps.name: Swipe the top bar
steps.detail: Right for Read / Unread and Pin; left for Note and Copy link.

steps.name: Press a button
steps.detail: It does the action and the bar closes.
